intent_contract.text: 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

Create one complex landscape editorial photograph that makes a randomly assigned barred-spiral-galaxy visual meaning independently inspectable in the same frame as an original visibly adult astronomer whose appearance is guided by the attached portrait in appearance-only reference mode.

Create a complex landscape editorial photograph inside an orbital observatory control room during a minor micrometeoroid alert. An original visibly adult astronomer with the reference portrait's visible facial structure, almond-shaped dark eyes with similar aperture and spacing, softly tapered lower-face shape, center-parted hairline, and long dark wavy hair adjusts a physical telescope control. Keep her face large, unobstructed, naturally textured, and clearly lit for appearance-only comparison. Beside her, a large nontext scientific observation display shows a sufficiently face-on barred spiral galaxy in false-color multiwavelength light: one luminous central bulge, an elongated stellar bar crossing the bulge, two spiral arms beginning near the opposite ends of the bar, and every structure embedded within one coherent galactic disk. Preserve a believable alert-state workspace, tactile controls, restrained urgency, and independent legibility of both the adult astronomer and the complete galaxy morphology.
